therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and anti-tumor immune response
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: participants with renal cell carcinoma at high risk of developing metastasis following nephrectomy

results.target_engagement_evidence: PD-L1 expression assessed by immunohistochemistry using SP142 assay
biomarker_changes: PD-L1 IC1/2/3 subgroup showed HR 0.83 (95% CI 0.63-1.10) for investigator-assessed DFS
subgroup_findings: PD-L1 IC1/2/3 participants showed numerically better DFS with atezolizumab vs placebo
IRF-assessed DFS in PD-L1 IC1/2/3 subgroup: HR 0.75 (95% CI 0.55-1.03), p=0.0735
results.dose_information: Atezolizumab 1200 mg IV infusion every 3 weeks
